features:
FRUIT FLAVORED SNACKS: No colors from artificial sources; Excellent source of vitamin C; Gluten free, gelatin free, and fat free

MADE WITH FRUIT AND VEGGIE JUICE: These snacks are made with pear, apple, and carrot juice concentrates; See nutritional panel on the box for a complete list of ingredients; Not intended to replace fruit or vegetables in the diet

FUN KIDS SNACK: Fruit flavored snacks in convenient, portable pouches; The perfect treat to include in a packed school lunch box

ON THE GO: These fruit flavored snacks are a quick and easy go-to that your whole family can enjoy

CONTAINS: Eight 8 oz boxes of Mott's Assorted Fruit Flavored Snacks; 10 pouches per box
ingredients: Corn Syrup, Sugar, Modified Corn Starch, Pear Juice Concentrate, Apple Juice Concentrate, Carrot Juice Concentrate. Contains 2% or less of: Citric Acid, Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), Sodium Citrate, Fruit Pectin, Malic Acid, Sunflower and/or Canola Oil, Vegetable and Fruit Juice added for Color, Natural Flavor, Carnauba Wax. Adds A Trivial Amount Of Fat
